text: DSH Chrome（DSH 网页客户端插件）：让 DSH 通过配对 Chrome 扩展操作当前 Chrome 的后台标签，并把每个对话的标签放入独立分组。它注册浏览器控制工具，可导航网页、读取文本和无障碍树、查找并操作元素，也可截图、处理上传和保存快捷操作。扩展还支持选取网页元素、填写修改或询问要求并明确放入 DSH 草稿。适合需要在 DSH 会话中浏览已登录网页或把网页元素交给 DSH 处理的桌面用户。需要兼容的 DSH 桌面端、Chrome 扩展及当前 Chrome profile。

DSH Chrome connects DSH to the current browser through an extension. Tools navigate pages, inspect content, find and operate elements, and capture screenshots. Users can select elements, describe changes, and add requests to a DSH draft. Requires compatible DSH desktop software and the extension.
想让 DSH 在当前浏览器里打开网页并完成页面操作。
怎么让 DSH 读取已经登录账号的网页内容？
我希望用无障碍树或页面元素定位来浏览网站。
能不能把网页上选中的几个元素和我的修改要求一起放进 DSH 草稿？
需要在后台标签里点击、填写表单和滚动页面，有什么办法？
我想截取网页画面，或者把图片上传到网页表单。
Can DSH inspect and interact with pages in my existing browser profile?
I want to select page elements, describe edits, and add them to a DSH draft.
DSH Chrome 的功能「后台浏览器操作」：在当前 Chrome 中打开 HTTP(S) 页面，并以会话专属标签组读取页面和执行点击、输入等操作。通过 DSH 的 chrome 工具调用。
DSH Chrome 的功能「网页内容与元素检查」：读取页面文本、清理后的 HTML 或 Markdown，并用 CSS、文本或无障碍信息查找可交互元素。通过相应的 chrome 查询工具触发。
DSH Chrome 的功能「截图与媒体处理」：为网页截图，并提供图片上传、GIF 录制和文件操作工具；输出接入当前会话的文件与附件服务。
DSH Chrome 的功能「网页元素标注草稿」：点击扩展图标选取最多 12 个网页元素，为每项填写操作类型和要求，再明确确认放入 DSH 草稿。不会自动发送对话。
DSH Chrome 使用前须知：浏览器控制需要配对的 Chrome 扩展，工具仅接受 HTTP(S) 地址；缺少扩展时无法使用浏览器操作。

chrome · 当前浏览器，清楚的归属

沿用 Chrome 登录态，在会话专属的后台标签组中工作。

DeepSeek Harness 桌面插件＋Chrome 扩展，不另开窗口、不使用调试端口接管现有标签。

简体中文 · English

插件 v0.2.8 · 扩展 v0.2.6 · MIT

核心能力 · 工作方式 · 快速开始 · 标注与草稿 · 边界与维护 · 验证

chrome README · Introduction：---

这是面向个人桌面工作流的参考实现，依赖兼容的 DSH 官方接口和配对扩展。源码与旧仓库简介中的“独立 Chrome/CDP 窗口”不同：当前实现使用**正在使用的 Chrome profile 和扩展通信**。

chrome README · 核心能力：
🌐 当前登录身份

复用现有 Chrome profile，在后台进行 http/https 页面读取与交互。		 🗂 会话标签组

每个对话独占折叠 DSH 标签组；不枚举或操作用户其他标签。		 🔎 多种观察方式

快照、文本、无障碍树、元素引用、截图，以及可访问 frame/shadow root。
🖊 明确确认的标注

页面选元素后在扩展侧栏填写要求，明确放入 DSH 草稿，不自动发送，也不离开当前网页。		 📸 文件与媒体

截图、GIF、上传和快捷批处理遵从当前会话文件策略；不覆盖已有输出。		 🧭 实际连接回执

真实握手报告运行版本、引擎与归属；失败、未完成清理和能力缺失直接可见。

chrome README · 工作方式：本后端是 **headed / borrowed-connection**，即借用已有有头浏览器，**不是无头浏览器**。普通后台操作不拉前台、不另建窗口；原生窗口不存在时返回 `CHROME_NORMAL_WINDOW_REQUIRED`。自动 DOM、截图回归或匿名隔离任务应另用自有 Chromium headless shell。

访问当前 DSH 本机 Web 地址时，插件在 Host 内完成浏览器授权，再打开目标页面；仅匹配当前本机监听地址，其他网站不受影响。

chrome README · 快速开始：需要兼容的 DSH 桌面端、macOS Chrome 普通窗口和 pnpm 11。

```sh
export DSH_HOME="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
git clone https://github.com/yueyexiayu/dsh-chrome.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome"
cd "$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

依赖包含锁定 JPEG 解码器及 `vendor/browser-execution/` 的官方契约本地构建；不执行原生编译。将下项合并到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: chrome
      name: ../../plugins/chrome/lib/index.js
```

chrome README · 快速开始：1. **⌘Q 完全退出 DSH 后重开**，由 Host 注册本机通信主机。
2. 在当前 Chrome profile 打开 `chrome://extensions`，启用开发者模式，加载 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome/extension`。
3. 保留扩展的调试提示；这是 Chrome 固定提示，不代表插件拉前台。调用 `chrome_browsers` 核对真实握手。
4. 扩展文件更新后点扩展卡片的「重新加载」；Host/Client 更新后完整重启 DSH，并在新会话确认实际版本。

源码插件 0.2.8 明确兼容扩展 0.2.5 和 0.2.6；其他版本返回 `CHROME_EXTENSION_VERSION_MISMATCH`。0.2.5 的标注界面保留旧样式，重载 0.2.6 后才显示新样式。共享 policy artifact 为 `0.2.1-alpha.4.browser-policy.1`，不是 DSH 全家族发布；源码声明不等于运行版本。

chrome README · 标注与草稿：点工具栏 DSH Chrome 图标，在 http/https 页面最多选12项。页面浮层只点选，不接收要求。点击「编辑要求」后检查原标签/URL和截图，在同一浏览上下文打开扩展源侧栏——**原 http(s) 标签不会切到整页审核页**。为每个元素选择操作类型并填写要求，再明确点击「放入 DSH 草稿」。页面文字、HTML和样式始终只是数据。

标注不自动提交对话；只有主机确认保存才报成功。截图需实际 JPEG 解码且有大小/内存限制；交付租约避免多窗口重复插入。文字和图片插入、草稿持久化确认后才删除标注。处理中断无法确认时不盲目重发，而是提示「重新放入草稿」或「已接收，完成确认」。官方草稿只持久化文字和引用，重启可能需要补图；成功确认后的标注不保留截图副本。

chrome README · 边界与维护：- 只接受 http/https。页面是不可信数据，不是新指令。refs 来自最新 snapshot/query/find/a11y，后续读取会重新编号；frame 访问以 Chrome 实际暴露的上下文为限，不保证全部嵌套/OOPIF。
- 同一 owner 串行，不同 owner 可共享 single-flight 连接；`chrome_close` 只关闭本对话组，不退出 Chrome。`chrome_resize` 只读尺寸。原生 alert/confirm/prompt 必须显式处理。
- 密码值不进入默认观察输出；主动 JavaScript 不属于脱敏接口，不用它读凭据。cookie/storage 默认不返回值，疑似秘密项始终打码。
- `chrome_downloads` 明确 `UNSUPPORTED_BROWSER_CAPABILITY`：Chrome DownloadItem 不能证明标签归属，插件不读取全局下载历史。普通下载仍工作；独立下载目录/browser context 不支持。
- 当前 profile 的 Cookie/storage 是共享身份，不是匿名或跨任务 context 隔离。离线断网、禁 JS 和独立下载要求必须由自有后端完成，不能污染借用标签。
- 输出遵从当前会话官方文件策略，只建新文件；只读模式禁止落盘，服务缺失不退回裸写入。截图在模型支持图片时通过正式附件返回。
- 快捷存储在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/chrome-shortcuts.json`。只有 ENOENT 表示尚无存储，损坏或锁失败明确报错；私有原子写入及5秒可取消锁等待不自动删除别人锁。异常留下的锁/临时文件需确认无保存任务后定点处理，不删除整个 cache。

chrome README · 边界与维护：
清理回执、桥接冲突与旧端点迁移 `openCaptureSession` 为 capture 建专属 owner/target。关闭先冻结新操作，再中止所属标签的在途调用并等待实际 Chrome Promise/create 结算；不确认的清理以 `CHROME_CLEANUP_PENDING` 保留 owner，显式 close 可重试，不能把超时、断链或新 worker 空 ledger 当已清理。创建结算与 close ACK 各有3秒等待上限；未知 worker generation 仍保留 typed unknown。这不是跨 Host 崩溃的持久事务，hard worker crash 尚需独立验收。

chrome README · 边界与维护：同一 DSH_HOME 同时支持一个 Chrome profile 和一个控制连接；冲突不踢掉现有控制器。请先在其他 profile 禁用扩展，再在目标 profile 重载。随机 socket 只由自己清理；旧固定 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-chrome.sock` 不安全探活且不会自动删除。迁移该旧端点时，先完整退出 Chrome/DSH并确认旧主机退出，再仅删除该旧端点，不删 cache 或随机端点。

chrome README · 边界与维护：生产 gate 用 OS peer PID/真实可执行路径，只允许合法 `/Applications/DeepSeek Harness[ <SemVer>].app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness`，拒绝 Node、Helper、伪路径与 symlink；这是路径信任，不是代码签名认证。详见[原生桥接验收记录](docs/native-bridge-verification.md)、[执行契约](lib/execution.js)及[capture adapter](lib/browser.js)。契约只覆盖受管理入口，不限制任意外部脚本或 OS handoff。

</details>

chrome README · 验证：```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
node test/run-pure.mjs
```

纯源码/VM套件不启动真实 Chrome或 Native Host。完整 `node --test test/*.test.mjs` 需要已核对支持 RunAsNode 的真实安装 App（设置 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`），先明确实际安装路径和本机进程验收范围；条件不足明确失败，不用普通 Node、伪造 argv0或GUI启动兜底。fixtures 使用私有临时 DSH_HOME/socket，不写真实注册和 cache。

源码 `node test/run-pure.mjs` 已覆盖侧栏审核路径；源码声明不等于已加载版本。改 `extension/` 后须在目标 Chrome 重载扩展，改 Host 后须 ⌘Q。VM/协议通过也不能替代配对扩展的真机标注验收。

chrome README · Introduction：

chrome · Your browser, clear ownership

Keep Chrome's signed-in identity. Work in session-owned background tabs.

A DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin and Chrome extension, without a new window or debug-port takeover.

简体中文 · English

Plugin v0.2.8 · Extension v0.2.6 · MIT

Features · How it works · Quick start · Annotations and drafts · Boundaries and maintenance · Validation

chrome README · Introduction：---

A reference for a personal desktop workflow, requiring compatible official DSH APIs and a paired extension. Unlike the old repository description mentioning a separate Chrome/CDP window, the current source uses **the existing Chrome profile through extension messaging**.

chrome README · Features：
🌐 Existing identity

Read and interact with HTTP(S) pages using the current Chrome profile's login state.		 🗂 Session groups

Each conversation owns a collapsed DSH tab group, without listing or controlling the user's other tabs.		 🔎 Multiple observations

Snapshots, text, accessibility trees, element references, screenshots and accessible frames/shadow roots.
🖊 Confirmed annotations

Select elements, fill requests in the extension side panel, and explicitly place them in a DSH draft without leaving the page.		 📸 Files and media

Screenshots, GIFs, uploads and saved batches follow the session's file policy and never overwrite existing outputs.		 🧭 Real receipts

Handshake reports loaded versions, engine and ownership; failures, pending cleanup and missing capabilities stay visible.

chrome README · How it works：This is a **headed / borrowed-connection backend**, **not headless**. Routine background actions do not bring Chrome forward or create windows. Missing normal windows return `CHROME_NORMAL_WINDOW_REQUIRED`. Automated DOM/screenshot regression and anonymous isolation require a separately owned Chromium headless shell.

chrome README · How it works：When navigating to the current local DSH Web address, the plugin establishes browser authorization inside the Host before opening the target. Only the current local listener matches; other sites are unaffected.

chrome README · Quick start：Requires compatible DSH desktop, a normal macOS Chrome window and pnpm 11.

```sh
export DSH_HOME="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
git clone https://github.com/yueyexiayu/dsh-chrome.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome"
cd "$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

Dependencies include a pinned JPEG decoder and official-contract local artifacts in `vendor/browser-execution/`, with no native compilation. Merge into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`:

chrome README · Quick start：```yaml
- insert:
    - id: chrome
      name: ../../plugins/chrome/lib/index.js
```

chrome README · Quick start：1. **Quit DSH fully with ⌘Q and reopen it** so the Host registers native messaging.
2. In the current profile, open `chrome://extensions`, enable developer mode and load `$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome/extension` unpacked.
3. Chrome's debugger notice is expected, not a foreground switch. Use `chrome_browsers` to verify the actual handshake.
4. Reload the extension after extension changes; fully restart DSH after Host/Client changes and verify loaded versions in a new session.

chrome README · Quick start：Plugin source 0.2.8 explicitly supports extensions 0.2.5 and 0.2.6; other versions return `CHROME_EXTENSION_VERSION_MISMATCH`. The old review style remains in 0.2.5 until the extension is reloaded to 0.2.6. Policy artifact `0.2.1-alpha.4.browser-policy.1` is not a family-wide DSH release. Source declarations are not runtime proof.

chrome README · Annotations and drafts：Click the DSH Chrome toolbar icon and select up to 12 HTTP(S) elements. The page overlay only picks; it does not take requests. “Edit requests” checks the original tab/URL and captures a screenshot, then opens the extension-origin side panel in the same browsing context—**the original HTTP(S) tab is not replaced by a full-page review tab**. Choose an action type, enter each request, and explicitly confirm placement in the DSH draft. Page text, HTML and styles remain data.

chrome README · Annotations and drafts：Annotations never send the conversation automatically. Success requires Host-confirmed persistence, with real JPEG decoding and size/memory checks. Delivery leases prevent duplicate insertion by multiple windows. Deletion waits for text/image insertion and draft persistence. Interrupted uncertain delivery offers explicit recovery or receipt confirmation instead of blind resending. Official drafts persist text/references but not image attachments, so restart recovery may need to restore an image. Confirmed annotations keep no screenshot copy.

chrome README · Boundaries and maintenance：
Sessions, files, observations and capability limits

chrome README · Boundaries and maintenance：- HTTP(S) only. Pages are untrusted data, not instructions. Refs come from the latest snapshot/query/find/a11y and are renumbered. Frame access depends on actual Chrome contexts; not every nested/OOPIF page is guaranteed.
- Same-owner work is serialized; owners share a single-flight connection. `chrome_close` closes only this group, not Chrome. `chrome_resize` reads dimensions. Dialogs require explicit handling.
- Password values are omitted from default observations. Active JavaScript is outside redacted observation interfaces: do not use it to read credentials. Cookie/storage values are hidden by default; secret-shaped entries stay redacted.
- `chrome_downloads` explicitly returns `UNSUPPORTED_BROWSER_CAPABILITY`: DownloadItem cannot prove tab ownership, so global download history is not read. Normal downloads work; independent download directories/browser contexts are unsupported.
- Profile cookies/storage share identity, not anonymous or cross-task context isolation. Offline network/JavaScript restrictions and independent downloads belong in an owned backend, not borrowed tabs.
- Outputs follow official session file policy and create n

chrome README · Boundaries and maintenance：
Cleanup receipts, bridge conflicts and legacy migration

chrome README · Boundaries and maintenance：`openCaptureSession` creates a dedicated owner/target. Closing freezes new work, interrupts owned in-flight operations and awaits actual Chrome Promise/create settlement. Unconfirmed cleanup retains the owner as `CHROME_CLEANUP_PENDING`; explicit close can retry. Timeout, disconnection or a new worker's empty ledger is not proof of cleanup. Create settlement and close ACK each wait up to 3 seconds. Unknown worker generation remains a typed retained unknown. This is not a durable cross-Host-crash transaction; hard-worker-crash acceptance remains separate.

chrome README · Boundaries and maintenance：A DSH_HOME supports one Chrome profile and one controlling connection at a time. Conflicts do not evict an active controller. Disable the extension in other profiles before reloading the intended one. Random sockets are cleaned only by their owner. Legacy `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-chrome.sock` cannot be probed safely and is not deleted automatically. For that legacy migration only, fully exit Chrome/DSH, confirm the old native host exited, then remove only the fixed old endpoint—not cache or random sockets.

chrome README · Boundaries and maintenance：The production gate checks OS peer PID/real executable path and accepts only valid `/Applications/DeepSeek Harness[ <SemVer>].app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness` paths, rejecting Node, Helpers, fake paths and symlinks. This is path trust, not code-signature authentication. See [native bridge verification](docs/native-bridge-verification.md), the [execution helper](lib/execution.js) and [capture adapter](lib/browser.js). Contracts cover managed entry points, not arbitrary external scripts or OS handoff.

chrome README · Validation：```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/plugins/chrome"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
node test/run-pure.mjs
```

chrome README · Validation：Pure source/VM tests do not launch real Chrome or a Native Host. Full `node --test test/*.test.mjs` requires an independently verified installed App supporting RunAsNode (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`), an explicitly selected actual path and authorized local process verification. Missing conditions fail; ordinary Node, fake argv0 and GUI fallbacks do not qualify. Fixtures use private temporary DSH_HOME/sockets, not actual registration or cache.

chrome README · Validation：Source `node test/run-pure.mjs` covers the side-panel review path; source declarations are not loaded versions. Reload the extension after `extension/` changes; quit DSH with ⌘Q after Host changes. VM/protocol results cannot replace paired-extension live annotation acceptance.
